implemented: Ordinary browser tab URLs, saved titles, explicit order and last-active browser selection survive restart.
Per-tab persistent IDs are separate from fresh runtime browser authority IDs.
Creation/address entry/navigation/title/selection/reorder/close schedule a200ms coalesced write; normal window close flushes.
Restoration suppresses intermediate writes, retains hidden content preference and restores blank tabs without applying custom New Tab URL.
Legacy profiles with no inventory use configured startup URL; explicitly saved empty inventory stays empty.
Versioned bounded JSON, atomic save, cooperating-writer lock/revision checks, profile directory identity check and invalid/externally changed state preservation.
HTTP/HTTPS/about:blank only; userinfo removed, encoded path/query/fragment preserved. Nonbrowser content is excluded.

host.scope: Real MainWindow/address-submit/tab-control/restart fixtures. Windows remain hidden and actual WebView navigation is not initialized; no external service or user profile.
warnings: QtTest reported a missing toolchain font directory. No visual parity or font-render claim derives from this functional suite.

limits: Not full Stagewise tab lifecycle parity: current native ordinary browser tabs are global; per-agent association/pinning/deferred restoration remain unimplemented.
Terminal/editor/app/image/side-chat content restoration is not supplied by this browser inventory. Existing side-chat lifecycle is independent.
No cross-product Stagewise profile import, navigation-stack/form/scroll/media/session-process restoration.
Persistence occurs after a200ms debounce plus close flush; abrupt termination before a pending write can lose the most recent tab update.
Atomic CAS coordinates cooperating writers. It does not claim race-free arbitrary external file writers or complete ancestor-reparse protection.
Save errors report status and preserve disk data; they do not prevent closing or implement a recovery/import UI.
No source/native screenshot or universal zero-defect claim.
independentReview: license_review bounded read of store/CAS/root identity/restore guards found no concrete additional defect; source review only.

hostHookEvidence.note: Parent migrated previous zero-tab expectation to one restored hidden tab and preserved width assertion.
